channel-type.label: Regulation State
channel-type.description: Regulation state reported by the controller

channel-type.label: Home Setpoint
channel-type.description: Persistent temperature used during Home periods

channel-type.label: Away/Sleeping Setpoint
channel-type.description: Persistent temperature used during Away and Sleeping periods

channel-type.label: Manual Setpoint
channel-type.description: Persistent temperature used in manual mode

channel-type.label: Current State
channel-type.description: Controller-reported overall state, independent of the Home override switch

channel-type.label: Home Override
channel-type.description: ON applies the staged room selection; OFF cancels Home

channel-type.label: Selected for Home
channel-type.description: Stage selection for the next Home activation. Living-zone rooms share the zone's selection. This does not change heating immediately.

channel-type.label: Pause
channel-type.description: ON starts or restarts a one-hour pause; OFF cancels Pause

channel-type.label: Pause Until
channel-type.description: Start or adjust Pause until a future date and time; reports the controller-confirmed deadline

channel-type.label: Vacation
channel-type.description: Enable a planned or immediate vacation, or cancel vacation and clear staged dates

channel-type.label: Vacation State
channel-type.description: Vacation state reported by the controller

channel-type.label: Vacation Start
channel-type.description: Stage the start while inactive, or update the start of a planned vacation

channel-type.label: Vacation End
channel-type.description: Stage the end while inactive, or update the end of a planned vacation
